INSERT INTO announcement_source_collection_requests ( id, provider_code, request_type_code, requested_by, requested_from, search_keyword, search_region_code, search_category_code, start_date, end_date, max_count, request_note, local_government_source_id, schedule_id, request_status_code, approved_by, approved_at, approval_note ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{providerCode}, #{requestTypeCode}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedFrom}, #{searchKeyword}, #{searchRegionCode}, #{searchCategoryCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{maxCount}, #{requestNote}, #{localGovernmentSourceId}, #{scheduleId}, coalesce(#{requestStatusCode}, 'APPROVAL_PENDING'), #{approvedBy}, CASE WHEN CAST(#{approvedBy} AS uuid) IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE NULL END, #{approvalNote} )
mapper.select:
-- Select external announcement collection requests. SELECT ascr.id AS request_id, ascr.public_code, ascr.provider_code, ascr.request_type_code, ascr.request_status_code, ascr.requested_by, ascr.requested_at, ascr.requested_from, ascr.search_keyword, ascr.search_region_code, ascr.search_category_code, ascr.start_date, ascr.end_date, ascr.max_count, ascr.request_note, ascr.local_government_source_id, ascr.schedule_id, ascr.approved_by, ascr.approved_at, ascr.approval_note, ascr.created_at, ascr.updated_at FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr
ORDER BY ascr.requested_at DESC, ascr.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count external announcement collection requests. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr

-- Select external announcement collection request details. SELECT ascr.id AS request_id, ascr.public_code, ascr.provider_code, ascr.request_type_code, ascr.request_status_code, ascr.requested_by, ascr.requested_at, ascr.requested_from, ascr.search_keyword, ascr.search_region_code, ascr.search_category_code, ascr.start_date, ascr.end_date, ascr.max_count, ascr.request_note, ascr.local_government_source_id, ascr.schedule_id, ascr.approved_by, ascr.approved_at, ascr.approval_note, ascr.created_at, ascr.updated_at FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr WHERE ascr.id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: -- Approve or reject external announcement collection request. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_requests SET request_status_code = #{requestStatusCode}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = now(), approval_note = #{approvalNote}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{requestId} AND request_status_code = 'APPROVAL_PENDING'
mapper.insert: -- Insert external announcement collection run. INSERT INTO announcement_source_collection_runs ( id, request_id, run_status_code, started_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{requestId}, #{runStatusCode}, now() )
mapper.update: -- Update external announcement collection run result. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_runs SET run_status_code = #{runStatusCode}, finished_at = now(), total_count = #{totalCount}, collected_count = #{collectedCount}, skipped_ended_count = #{skippedEndedCount}, duplicate_count = #{duplicateCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{runId}
mapper.select:
-- Select external announcement collection runs. SELECT ascrun.id AS run_id, ascrun.public_code, ascrun.request_id, ascr.public_code AS request_public_code, ascr.provider_code, ascr.request_type_code, ascrun.run_status_code, ascrun.started_at, ascrun.finished_at, ascrun.total_count, ascrun.collected_count, ascrun.skipped_ended_count, ascrun.duplicate_count, ascrun.failed_count, ascrun.error_message, ascrun.created_at FROM announcement_source_collection_runs ascrun INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests ascr ON ascr.id = ascrun.request_id
ORDER BY ascrun.created_at DESC, ascrun.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count external announcement collection runs. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_collection_runs ascrun INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests ascr ON ascr.id = ascrun.request_id

-- Select external announcement collection run details. SELECT ascrun.id AS run_id, ascrun.public_code, ascrun.request_id, ascr.public_code AS request_public_code, ascr.provider_code, ascr.request_type_code, ascrun.run_status_code, ascrun.started_at, ascrun.finished_at, ascrun.total_count, ascrun.collected_count, ascrun.skipped_ended_count, ascrun.duplicate_count, ascrun.failed_count, ascrun.error_message, ascrun.created_at FROM announcement_source_collection_runs ascrun INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests ascr ON ascr.id = ascrun.request_id WHERE ascrun.id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert external announcement collection run item. INSERT INTO announcement_source_collection_run_items ( id, run_id, source_id, provider_notice_id, source_url, item_status_code, error_message ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{runId}, #{sourceId}, #{providerNoticeId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{itemStatusCode}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.select: -- Select external announcement collection run items. SELECT ascri.id AS item_id, ascri.run_id, ascri.source_id, ass.public_code AS source_public_code, ascri.provider_notice_id, ascri.source_url, ascri.item_status_code, ascri.error_message, ascri.created_at FROM announcement_source_collection_run_items ascri LEFT JOIN announcement_source_snapshots ass ON ass.id = ascri.source_id WHERE ascri.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY ascri.created_at ASC, ascri.id ASC
mapper.insert: -- Insert immutable external announcement source snapshot. INSERT INTO announcement_source_snapshots ( id, provider_code, provider_notice_id, title, agency_name, application_start_date, application_end_date, posted_at, modified_at, source_url, body_text, inquiry_text, application_method_text, source_completeness_code, missing_fields_json, raw_payload_json, raw_hash, review_status_code, local_government_source_id, canonical_source_url, normalized_title, normalized_agency_name, posted_date ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{providerCode}, #{providerNoticeId}, #{title}, #{agencyName}, #{applicationStartDate}, #{applicationEndDate}, #{postedAt}, #{modifiedAt}, #{sourceUrl}, #{bodyText}, #{inquiryText}, #{applicationMethodText}, #{sourceCompletenessCode}, CAST(#{missingFieldsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS jsonb), #{rawHash}, #{reviewStatusCode}, #{localGovernmentSourceId}, #{canonicalSourceUrl}, #{normalizedTitle}, #{normalizedAgencyName}, #{postedDate} )
mapper.select: -- Select source snapshot by provider notice id. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.provider_notice_id, ass.title, ass.agency_name, ass.application_start_date, ass.application_end_date, ass.posted_at, ass.modified_at, ass.source_url, ass.body_text, ass.inquiry_text, ass.application_method_text, ass.source_completeness_code, ass.missing_fields_json::text AS missing_fields_json, ass.raw_hash, ass.review_status_code, ass.collected_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass WHERE ass.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND ass.provider_notice_id = #{providerNoticeId}

-- Select source snapshot by provider url. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.provider_notice_id, ass.title, ass.agency_name, ass.application_start_date, ass.application_end_date, ass.posted_at, ass.modified_at, ass.source_url, ass.body_text, ass.inquiry_text, ass.application_method_text, ass.source_completeness_code, ass.missing_fields_json::text AS missing_fields_json, ass.raw_hash, ass.review_status_code, ass.collected_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass WHERE ass.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND ass.source_url = #{sourceUrl}

-- Select source snapshot by raw payload hash. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.provider_notice_id, ass.title, ass.agency_name, ass.application_start_date, ass.application_end_date, ass.posted_at, ass.modified_at, ass.source_url, ass.body_text, ass.inquiry_text, ass.application_method_text, ass.source_completeness_code, ass.missing_fields_json::text AS missing_fields_json, ass.raw_hash, ass.review_status_code, ass.collected_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass WHERE ass.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND ass.raw_hash = #{rawHash}

-- Find title and agency matches that require operator review. SELECT FROM announcement_source_snapshots src INNER JOIN announcement_source_snapshots ass ON ass.id <> src.id AND ass.provider_code <> src.provider_code AND ass.normalized_title = src.normalized_title AND ass.normalized_agency_name = src.normalized_agency_name WHERE src.id = #{sourceId} AND NOT ( (ass.canonical_source_url IS NOT NULL AND ass.canonical_source_url = src.canonical_source_url) OR (src.posted_date IS NOT NULL AND ass.posted_date = src.posted_date) ) ORDER BY ass.collected_at DESC, ass.id DESC LIMIT 20

-- Select cross-provider duplicate and similar candidates for one source. SELECT assd.id AS duplicate_id, #{sourceId} AS source_id, candidate.id AS candidate_source_id, candidate.public_code AS candidate_public_code, candidate.provider_code AS candidate_provider_code, candidate.title AS candidate_title, candidate.agency_name AS candidate_agency_name, candidate.posted_date AS candidate_posted_date, candidate.source_url AS candidate_source_url, assd.match_type_code, assd.title_matched, assd.agency_matched, assd.posted_date_matched, assd.source_url_matched, assd.match_reason, assd.decision_status_code, assd.decided_by, assd.decided_at, assd.decision_note FROM announcement_source_snapshot_duplicates assd INNER JOIN announcement_source_snapshots candidate ON candidate.id = CASE WHEN assd.source_id = #{sourceId} THEN assd.candidate_source_id ELSE assd.source_id END WHERE assd.source_id = #{sourceId} OR assd.candidate_source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY CASE assd.match_type_code WHEN 'EXACT_DUPLICATE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, candidate.collected_at ASC, assd.id ASC
mapper.update: -- Save operator decision for one cross-provider similar candidate. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshot_duplicates SET decision_status_code = #{decisionStatusCode}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), decision_note = #{decisionNote}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{duplicateId} AND (source_id = #{sourceId} OR candidate_source_id = #{sourceId}) AND match_type_code = 'SIMILAR' AND decision_status_code = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: -- Count pending cross-provider similar candidates before DRAFT conversion. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_snapshot_duplicates assd WHERE (assd.source_id = #{sourceId} OR assd.candidate_source_id = #{sourceId}) AND assd.match_type_code = 'SIMILAR' AND assd.decision_status_code = 'PENDING'

-- Select external announcement source snapshots. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.provider_notice_id, ass.title, ass.agency_name, ass.application_start_date, ass.application_end_date, ass.posted_at, ass.modified_at, ass.source_url, ass.body_text, ass.inquiry_text, ass.application_method_text, ass.source_completeness_code, ass.missing_fields_json::text AS missing_fields_json, ass.raw_hash, ass.review_status_code, ass.collected_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass
ORDER BY ass.collected_at DESC, ass.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count external announcement source snapshots. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass

-- Select external announcement source details. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.provider_notice_id, ass.title, ass.agency_name, ass.application_start_date, ass.application_end_date, ass.posted_at, ass.modified_at, ass.source_url, ass.body_text, ass.inquiry_text, ass.application_method_text, ass.source_completeness_code, ass.missing_fields_json::text AS missing_fields_json, ass.raw_hash, ass.review_status_code, ass.collected_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass WHERE ass.id = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert source attachment url. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachments ( id, source_id, file_name, file_url, file_type_code, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{attachmentId}, #{sourceId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileTypeCode}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: -- Select source attachment urls. SELECT asa.id AS attachment_id, asa.source_id, asa.file_name, asa.file_url, asa.file_type_code, asa.sort_order FROM announcement_source_attachments asa WHERE asa.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY asa.sort_order ASC, asa.id ASC
mapper.insert: -- Insert source highlight reference. INSERT INTO announcement_source_highlights ( id, source_id, highlight_type_code, matched_text, start_offset, end_offset, line_no, match_rule_code ) VALUES ( #{highlightId}, #{sourceId}, #{highlightTypeCode}, #{matchedText}, #{startOffset}, #{endOffset}, #{lineNo}, #{matchRuleCode} )
mapper.select: -- Select source highlights. SELECT ash.id AS highlight_id, ash.source_id, ash.highlight_type_code, ash.matched_text, ash.start_offset, ash.end_offset, ash.line_no, ash.match_rule_code FROM announcement_source_highlights ash WHERE ash.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY ash.line_no ASC NULLS LAST, ash.start_offset ASC NULLS LAST, ash.id ASC

-- Select active operational announcements that may duplicate a collected source. SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS candidate_id, src.id AS source_id, a.id AS announcement_id, a.public_code AS announcement_code, a.title AS announcement_title, a.agency_name, a.application_start_date, a.application_end_date, a.manual_status_code, a.approval_status_code, linked_src.public_code AS linked_source_code, linked_src.provider_notice_id AS linked_provider_notice_id, linked_src.source_url AS linked_source_url, CASE WHEN ( coalesce(src.source_url IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.source_url = src.source_url, false) OR coalesce(src.provider_notice_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.provider_notice_id = src.provider_notice_id, false) OR ( lower(trim(a.title)) = lower(trim(src.title)) AND lower(trim(coalesce(a.agency_name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(src.agency_name, ''))) AND a.application_start_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_start_date AND a.application_end_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_end_date ) ) THEN 'EXACT_DUPLICATE' ELSE 'SIMILAR' END AS match_type_code, lower(trim(a.title)) = lower(trim(src.title)) AS title_matched, lower(trim(coalesce(a.agency_name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(src.agency_name, ''))) AS agency_matched, coalesce(src.provider_notice_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.provider_notice_id = src.provider_notice_id, false) AS provider_notice_matched, ( a.application_start_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_start_date AND a.application_end_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_end_date ) AS period_matched, coalesce(src.source_url IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.source_url = src.source_url, false) AS source_url_matched, concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN lower(trim(a.title)) = lower(trim(src.title)) THEN '사업명 일치' END, CASE WHEN lower(trim(coalesce(a.agency_name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(src.agency_name, ''))) THEN '주관기관 일치' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(src.provider_notice_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.provider_notice_id = src.provider_notice_id, false) THEN '공고번호 일치' END, CASE WHEN a.application_start_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_start_date AND a.application_end_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_end_date THEN '신청기간 일치' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(src.source_url IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.source_url = src.source_url, false) THEN '원문 URL 일치' END, CASE WHEN lower(a.title) LIKE concat('%', lower(src.title), '%') OR lower(src.title) LIKE concat('%', lower(a.title), '%') THEN '사업명 유사' END, CASE WHEN lower(trim(coalesce(a.agency_name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(src.agency_name, ''))) AND NOT ( a.application_start_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_start_date AND a.application_end_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.application_end_date ) THEN '같은 기관의 기간 겹침 후보' END ) AS similarity_reason, 'PENDING' AS decision_status_code, CAST(NULL AS uuid) AS decided_by, CAST(NULL AS timestamptz) AS decided_at, CAST(NULL AS text) AS decision_note, now() AS created_at, now() AS updated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots src INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN announcement_source_links asl ON asl.announcement_id = a.id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_snapshots linked_src ON linked_src.id = asl.source_id WHERE src.id = #{sourceId} AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL' AND (a.application_end_date IS NULL OR a.application_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) AND ( coalesce(src.source_url IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.source_url = src.source_url, false) OR coalesce(src.provider_notice_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_src.provider_notice_id = src.provider_notice_id, false) OR lower(trim(a.title)) = lower(trim(src.title)) OR ( lower(trim(coalesce(a.agency_name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(src.agency_name, ''))) AND ( a.application_start_date IS NULL OR src.application_end_date IS NULL OR a.application_start_date <= src.application_end_date ) AND ( a.application_end_date IS NULL OR src.application_start_date IS NULL OR a.application_end_date >= src.application_start_date ) ) OR lower(a.title) LIKE concat('%', lower(src.title), '%') OR lower(src.title) LIKE concat('%', lower(a.title), '%') )
mapper.insert: -- Insert duplicate or similar announcement candidate for operator review. INSERT INTO announcement_source_duplicate_candidates ( id, source_id, announcement_id, match_type_code, title_matched, agency_matched, provider_notice_matched, period_matched, source_url_matched, similarity_reason ) VALUES ( #{candidateId}, #{sourceId}, #{announcementId}, #{matchTypeCode}, #{titleMatched}, #{agencyMatched}, #{providerNoticeMatched}, #{periodMatched}, #{sourceUrlMatched}, #{similarityReason} ) ON CONFLICT (source_id, announcement_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
-- Select duplicate or similar candidates for a source. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_duplicate_candidates asdc INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = asdc.announcement_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_links asl ON asl.announcement_id = a.id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_snapshots linked_src ON linked_src.id = asl.source_id WHERE asdc.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY CASE asdc.match_type_code WHEN 'EXACT_DUPLICATE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, a.application_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, asdc.created_at ASC, asdc.id ASC

-- Count pending duplicate or similar candidates for a source. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_duplicate_candidates asdc WHERE asdc.source_id = #{sourceId} AND asdc.decision_status_code = 'PENDING'

-- Count pending exact duplicate candidates for a source. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_duplicate_candidates asdc WHERE asdc.source_id = #{sourceId} AND asdc.match_type_code = 'EXACT_DUPLICATE' AND asdc.decision_status_code = 'PENDING'

-- Select duplicate or similar candidate details. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_duplicate_candidates asdc INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = asdc.announcement_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_links asl ON asl.announcement_id = a.id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_snapshots linked_src ON linked_src.id = asl.source_id WHERE asdc.source_id = #{sourceId} AND asdc.id = #{candidateId}
mapper.update: -- Update duplicate candidate operator decision. UPDATE announcement_source_duplicate_candidates SET decision_status_code = #{decisionStatusCode}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), decision_note = #{decisionNote}, updated_at = now() WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND id = #{candidateId} AND decision_status_code = 'PENDING'
-- Update source review status. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET review_status_code = #{reviewStatusCode}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId}
mapper.select: -- Count linked operational announcements that are approved and normally exposed. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_links asl INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = asl.announcement_id WHERE asl.source_id = #{sourceId} AND a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL'
mapper.insert: -- Insert source review status history. INSERT INTO announcement_source_review_histories ( id, source_id, previous_status_code, next_status_code, reason, changed_by ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{sourceId}, #{previousStatusCode}, #{nextStatusCode}, #{reason}, #{changedBy} )

-- Link external source snapshot and operational announcement. INSERT INTO announcement_source_links ( id, source_id, announcement_id, linked_by ) VALUES ( #{linkId}, #{sourceId}, #{announcementId}, #{linkedBy} ) ON CONFLICT (source_id, announcement_id) DO NOTHING
